description: MarsWalk is an offline planner for a two-person walk on Mars at the boxwork ridges of Mount Sharp, Gale Crater, where Curiosity drove in 2025. It puts HiRISE elevation and imagery, THEMIS, CRISM and Curiosity images on one 3 m grid and plans like a crew would have to: which science stops are worth the energy, which route a suited human can walk, when the crew must turn back, and what to do if one astronaut is injured or a solar storm starts. Everything runs in the browser without a link to Earth
